description: The rootfs images a player may hold, known by their digests (plan, stage 6: the user's installation without a history). The identity probe reads the rootfs's first blocks (first_blocks_bytes, the collectors profile's probe_blocks) and compares their SHA-256 with first_blocks_sha256. Stock is the official rootfs padded to the writer's size; every boot release from 2.57.5 records its own image (releases/<v>.json, image), built reproducibly from FiiO's update and the release; the images before it are listed here. Digests only: no firmware is kept in this repository.
